description:
[Gorgeous, Obsessive, Affectionate Top ‘Cheongseon’ X Big, Potato, Innocent Bottom ‘Mokhun’]

Mokhun, a recessive omega with a long string of failed relationships, is devastated when he hears that the coworker he had a crush on is getting married. To make matters worse, a sudden heat hits him, leading to a frantic one-night stand with an alpha who is a complete stranger to him.

Later, when his one-night partner Cheongseon reaches out, Mokhun nervously agrees to meet up. Instead of brushing things off, Cheongseon casually drops a shocking confession claiming that night was the best experience he’s ever had, one that could never be topped...

*“I... want to bond with you.”*

*“I don’t get it... Cheongseon is a dominant alpha on a completely different level from me... Why would someone like him choose someone as ordinary as me?”*
